reuse.why: Consolidates the three copied category queries and setZero's view query into one getMonthWideBudgetCategories helper that every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth, now uses.

duplication.why: Removes the triplicated SQL and the separate hidden check in copyPreviousMonth; the rule exists in one query.

placement.why: The helper sits in budget/actions.ts directly above the actions it serves.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, tests and a release note; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: A single, small selection function owns the rule; its comment describes the excluded categories while the function returns the included ones, which is slightly confusing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five month-wide actions use getMonthWideBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the copies are removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.
